metadata.title: The Learning Council — Phase 3: Cross-Seat Nominations & Consensus Tally

rationales.COG: Generates the hypercorrection effect and forces retrieval-induced active prediction, dismantling the illusion of explanatory depth.
rationales.TEA: Enforces the mandatory Step 1 predict-then-reveal pedagogical invariant, compelling active hypothesis generation prior to instruction.
rationales.GAM: Transforms passive reading into active ludic commitment by creating curiosity and stakes before the mechanical reveal.
rationales.ADV: Removes fear of failure by establishing a zero-penalty prediction space that rewards curiosity rather than perfection.
rationales.DAT: Captures pristine pre-instruction prior belief states versus post-instruction accuracy to quantify true single-step normalized learning gain.
rationales.TEC: Executes as a lightweight deterministic client-side state machine with zero API roundtrip latency and instant UI feedback.
rationales.ECO: Yields the highest learner engagement and completion rate lift per engineering dollar spent of any pedagogical interaction.

top_5_finalists_for_phase4_debate.name: Dynamic Henderson-Hasselbalch pH-Compartment Ionization & Permeability Chamber

rationales.COG: Dual-codes abstract logarithmic pKa equilibrium into simultaneous visual-spatial compartments of ionized vs unionized species.
rationales.TEA: Deconstructs the most persistent 3rd-year conceptual stumbling block: predicting drug absorption, clearance, and blood-brain barrier permeability from ionization.
rationales.GAM: Delivers an engaging tactile simulation where adjusting the pH slider produces immediate kinetic consequences on molecular permeability.
rationales.DAT: Yields continuous slider-adjustment telemetry that captures the exact inflection point where student intuition diverges from physicochemical reality.
rationales.TEC: Renders closed-form physicochemical equations via client-side SVG and Canvas at 60 FPS without requiring any backend server compute.
rationales.ECO: Functions as the premier high-conversion demonstration widget in free preview lessons, accelerating freemium-to-paid trial conversion.

rationales.COG: Calibrates scaffolding dynamically across 3 cognitive tiers to maintain desirable difficulty without working-memory exhaustion.
rationales.TEA: Provides structured pedagogical fading that prevents student surrender during challenging SAR derivations while fostering autonomous problem solving.
rationales.GAM: Establishes a progressive hint unlock economy that preserves flow state and prevents game-over frustration during difficult steps.
rationales.ADV: Eliminates dead-end cognitive paralysis and shame during late-night solo study by offering accessible, non-judgmental hint ladders.
rationales.DAT: Quantifies latent knowledge state transitions by measuring exact hint-depth consumption (Nudge vs Clue vs Solution) prior to item success.
rationales.ECO: Provides an infinitely reusable, template-driven scaffolding system across all 22 modules, drastically minimizing authoring and QA expenses.

top_5_finalists_for_phase4_debate.name: Ebbinghaus-Pimsleur Half-Life Decay Spaced Retrieval Scheduler

rationales.COG: Calculates individualized memory half-life decay curves to trigger synaptic consolidation before forgetting thresholds occur.
rationales.TEA: Ensures foundational autonomic receptor pharmacology is systematically reinforced across later medicinal chemistry modules through scheduled spaced review.
rationales.ADV: Protects exhausted pharmacy students' limited 15-30 minute study windows by eliminating wasteful over-practice and cramming anxiety.
rationales.DAT: Generates high-resolution longitudinal retention telemetry, calibrating empirical forgetting curve parameters for each learner-concept pair.
rationales.TEC: Runs completely client-side via LocalStorage and IndexedDB, providing offline-capable spaced scheduling with zero recurring cloud compute costs.
rationales.ECO: Drives 30-day retention and semester-long subscription renewal rates at zero marginal cloud compute or API cost.

top_5_finalists_for_phase4_debate.name: Split-Screen Bioisosteric Replacement Sandbox with Real-Time Delta Readout

rationales.TEA: Bridges the didactic gap between 2D chemical structure and clinical consequence through interactive functional group bioisosterism manipulation.
rationales.GAM: Creates a high-agency molecular sandbox where students freely swap functional groups like tactile building blocks with instant visual reward.
rationales.DAT: Logs exploratory navigation paths through chemical property space, differentiating systematic structure-activity deduction from random search.
rationales.TEC: Computes molecular property deltas (logP, pKa, MW) in-browser via lightweight deterministic lookup tables and Wasm routines.
rationales.ECO: Serves as the flagship commercial value differentiator for the Medicinal Chemistry course, establishing a defensible competitive moat.

runners_up_ranks_6_to_10.name: Strict 40-Word Cognitive Load Guardrail & Build-Time Linter

rationales.COG: Imposes a hard 40-word ceiling to eliminate extraneous cognitive load and prevent working-memory buffer overflow on mobile displays.
rationales.ADV: Eliminates student cognitive fatigue and screen exhaustion by strictly outlawing dense, impenetrable walls of textbook prose.
rationales.TEC: Enforces cognitive content constraints programmatically via automated build-time Markdown AST linters and CI quality gates.
rationales.ECO: Slashes curriculum authoring, editing, and bilingual translation costs by over 50% by enforcing strict word count brevity at compile time.

runners_up_ranks_6_to_10.name: Misconception-Targeted Diagnostic Distractors with Zero-Shame Formative Alerts

rationales.COG: Exploits error-driven reconsolidation by explicitly activating and falsifying entrenched student misconceptions with targeted diagnostic alerts.
rationales.TEA: Decontaminates multiple-choice questions by diagnosing specific named 3rd-year misconceptions rather than trivial arithmetic or recall errors.
rationales.ADV: Replaces demoralizing 'incorrect' alerts with empathetic, constructive diagnostic explanations that validate student reasoning.
rationales.DAT: Maximizes psychometric item discrimination by mapping each distractor selection to a distinct latent misconception node.

runners_up_ranks_6_to_10.name: Offline-First Service Worker & IndexedDB State Persistence Engine
runners_up_ranks_6_to_10.theme_name: Scalable Architecture, Wasm Cheminformatics & Deterministic AI

rationales.ADV: Guarantees stress-free offline learning continuity during hospital basement rotations and subway commutes without data dropouts.
rationales.TEC: Delivers an offline-first PWA architecture with Service Worker caching and IndexedDB synchronization, ensuring 100% uptime in poor network conditions.
rationales.ECO: Reduces Firebase Firestore read and write operations by over 80% through local persistence, directly protecting the target 93%+ gross margins.

runners_up_ranks_6_to_10.name: Bilingual Medical Terminology Tooltip Swapper & Turkish-English Crosswalk
runners_up_ranks_6_to_10.theme_name: Friction Reduction, Student Fatigue & Bilingual Usability

rationales.TEA: Seamlessly bridges Turkish pharmacy curriculum terminology ('Farmasötik Kimya') with international English board exam nomenclature.
rationales.ADV: Removes second-language cognitive friction for Turkish students, preventing translation delays from obstructing pharmacology comprehension.
rationales.ECO: Expands the platform's addressable market to Turkey with negligible localization overhead, unlocking substantial regional subscription revenue.

runners_up_ranks_6_to_10.name: Tactile Log-Dose Step Slider & Real-Time Emax/EC50 Curve Manipulator

rationales.TEA: Viscerally separates efficacy (vertical Emax ceiling) from potency (horizontal EC50 shift) on interactive sigmoidal dose-response curves.
rationales.GAM: Translates abstract logarithmic dose equations into a responsive elastic curve-bending interaction with rich tactile feedback.
rationales.DAT: Records parameter estimation error and micro-hesitation latencies during curve manipulation to assess numerical and pharmacological intuition.

moderate_consensus_pool.name: AChE Catalytic Triad Hydrolysis & Organophosphate Aging Time-Stepper

rationales.GAM: Turns irreversible covalent enzyme inhibition into a dramatic time-stepper puzzle, illustrating aging and oxime rescue before the chemical deadline.
rationales.TEC: Simulates multi-step enzyme catalytic triad kinetics and aging time-constants deterministically through a lightweight client-side state engine.

rationales.COG: Interleaves sympathetic and parasympathetic retrieval queries to induce cross-system discriminative contrast and prevent categorized rote memorization.
